title: Grateful Dead Live at Boston Garden on 1994-10-01
lineage: MAD > Sony TC-D8 > Optical out > Edirol FA-66 > Wavelab 1648 > R8Brain > CD-Wave > TLH > FLAC 1644 tagged. Recording & transfer by Andrew F. 02/2015
source: AUD: Nakamichi CM300/CP4 shotguns > Casio DA-7 > TDK DC4 DAT. Mics on 7-foot stand, end of floor, center & straight back by the hockey wall.

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear Nak300 recording praised as the best sounding source, though no musical details are given.
ai_review.review: Reviewers rave about the exceptional audio fidelity of this Nak300 capture, calling it superior to other high‑end microphone recordings and a must‑listen. No comments were made about the band's performance or setlist.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one review, but it gives a perfect 5‑star rating for audio quality; no information on show quality, so rating reflects excellent recording with limited data.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Review highlights the Nak300 mics delivering superb clarity and surpassing other expensive microphone setups; no noted flaws.
